body.x: Smart Wellness will be exhibiting CUBROID, an educational coding robot, at CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA, from Jan. 8 (Tue) to 11 (Fri).

CUBROID is the world's first wireless-based IoT smart block. You can make any shapes you want by using shape blocks, connecting blocks, DC motors, proximity sensor blocks, and so on. It is 100% compatible with Lego, which makes it more scalable to make any shape.

Features of CUBROID are as follows. △ It is possible to assemble robots more easily than LEGO. △ It has block for wireless communication and is the first AI block in the world. △ It has software that can be easily coded by smart device. △ Anyone can operate robot platform

CUBROID said, "We are receiving favorable comments from countries around the world such as the US, Europe and China." We aim to expand our exports to 20 countries by 2020 and 50 countries by 2020 in six countries by 2018. "

Meanwhile, 'CES', the largest IT exhibition in the world, is an exhibition where one can grasp the flow of the home electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS, a global news network that most reported the issues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions over the last twelve years, has sent a special report team to CES this year to report major issues in the world market, and introduce major Korean companies to the world.
